top5.title: Nvidia board rules out Jensen Huang’s return as CEO
top5.description: Nvidia’s board chair said Jensen Huang’s resignation was unanimously accepted and that the board did not plan to reinstate him as CEO. Huang nevertheless said he would be honored to return if the board decided that was preferable.
top5.why: Nvidia’s CEO succession crisis creates major uncertainty for the company’s strategy, investor confidence and control of the AI-chip supply chain.

top5.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and the cheaper Sol model
top5.description: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.2 Astra for coding, research, documents and complex spreadsheets, as well as Sol for everyday tasks. The company says Astra outperforms its previous model on a professional benchmark while costing less, but early feedback points to steering difficulties and inconsistent results.
top5.why: OpenAI’s cheaper, more capable GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol models intensify price and performance competition across enterprise AI, despite early reliability concerns.

top5.title: Popular Websites Compromised to Steal Cryptocurrency
top5.description: Attackers injected malicious JavaScript into the websites of 178 organizations, including Zoom, HSBC, Equifax, CNN, Salesforce, and IKEA. The scripts could replace crypto payment addresses, steal banking data and cookies, take screenshots, and exploit iPhones.
top5.why: A coordinated compromise of 178 major websites demonstrates the growing scale and sophistication of supply-chain cyberattacks, with direct risks to payments, credentials and customer data.

top5.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion to accelerate drug discovery
top5.description: Isomorphic Labs, Demis Hassabis’s AI drug-discovery company, has raised $5 billion in a Series C round. The company wants to develop its drug-design engine and its own therapeutic pipeline, though this does not guarantee a shortcut to approved treatments.
top5.why: Isomorphic Labs’ $5 billion financing is a landmark bet on AI-driven drug discovery and could reshape competition between technology and pharmaceutical companies.

top5.title: Google’s AI answers reduce clicks to websites by 40%
top5.description: A randomized experiment indicates that Google’s AI Overviews reduce clicks to external websites by about 40%. They now appear in 61% of tracked searches in the United States.
top5.why: Evidence that Google AI Overviews reduce external clicks by about 40% signals a potentially disruptive shift in traffic, advertising and business models across the web.
